top_signals.title: Cboe Eyes VIX Perpetual Futures as Exchanges Move Beyond Crypto
top_signals.summary: Cboe Global Markets Inc. is looking at listing perpetual futures based on the Cboe Volatility Index, as US exchanges race to bring the highly levered instruments that dominate the crypto market to new asset classes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Next OpenAIs and Anthropics may come straight to retail market. Here's what to know before investing
top_signals.summary: The SEC wants retail investors to access private markets, and with all the hype around tech darlings going public, there's plenty of potential reward and risk.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: France meets fiscal reality with a crunch
top_signals.summary: A surge in borrowing costs leaves the country on the edge of a debt spiral
